text:
Alex: Hey team — customer (AcmeBank) asked for final BOM and upgrade cadence for an air-gapped POC. They need: installer artifact, expected bundle size, how we do security patches, and pricing for offline licensing. Anyone have the latest checklist?
Mira: I can own the POC checklist. For packaging we have two options: full offline bundle (tar.gz with container images + manifests) or OCI tar export. Full bundle size ~ 4.2GB for base LLM/runtime + tools, deltas ~200-400MB. We can strip optional models to reduce size.
Priya: Security notes: offline bundle is signed and we provide SHA256 + GPG signature. Customer will need to import our signing public key into their vault. KMS/HSM integrations require networked KMS or offline keywrap — both supported, doc'd. Also FIPS mode supported on request.
Sam: Upgrade cadence: we recommend quarterly minor releases and monthly security hotfixes. For airgap there's an offline delta updater: customer runs `./apply_delta.sh --bundle /tmp/rw-delta.tar` (signed). We support rollback by keeping last N images. We'll provide a checklist for pre-upgrade snapshot + healthcheck script.
Jordan: Pricing: for POC we usually do a time-limited offline bundle license (no infra surcharge) + optional Dedicated reserved pricing for production. For offline support there's a one-time packaging fee + annual support SLA. I'll pull numbers into the quote.
Alex: @Mira can you attach the BOM and the sample command we give Ops? Also can we confirm EOL windows for older quantized models?
Mira: attaching (will post link) — sample command:
```
# apply delta
sha256sum -c bundle.sig && ./apply_delta.sh --bundle rw-delta-v1.2.tar.gz
```
And BOM fields: images, checksums, signatures, required kernel driver versions, GPU driver matrix, minimum disk 30GB.
Priya: Customer asked about audit logs. We provide local audit collector + optional remote syslog forwarder; audit entries include user, api_key_id, operation, model_version.
Sam: Ops healthcheck snippet:
```
curl -sS --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock http://localhost/health | jq .
```
We also expose token-level cost telemetry but that's blocked in airgap unless they permit a telemetry collector to reach our endpoint; otherwise we provide offline billing reports.
Jordan: I'll confirm quote line items. Alex — can you set meeting with their infra lead tomorrow? Slot 11am PT? :calendar: 
Alex: 11am PT works. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Artifact rw-delta-v1.2.tar.gz uploaded to artifacts.redwood (signed)
Mira: I'll share the packaged BOM + checklist after the call and add the delta patching runbook to the customer repo.
